findings.title: Tasks do not provide executable code for required backend and frontend test coverage
findings.problem: The required CompanyId, exact-code precedence, mixed-case search, deterministic ordering, beyond-last-page, paging, authorization, and paginated frontend scenarios are described but not supplied as complete files or exact insertion snippets. Existing tests still use array-shaped query responses and string query arguments.
findings.fix: Provide a complete replacement or exact anchored code blocks for the integration test and CustomerOnboarding Vitest test, including every required scenario and fixture change.

findings.title: Tasks are not self-contained for the requested end-to-end scope
findings.location: tasks.md Unchanged prerequisites; design.md implementation-ordered task list
findings.problem: Backend domain/contracts/EF/repository-DI/helpers/CQRS stages and frontend page/components/routes/navigation are only asserted as prerequisites, with no executable verification or copy/paste coverage despite the requested task coverage.
findings.fix: Add dependency-ordered exact tasks for each required stage, or explicitly narrow requirements and tasks to a gap-only patch and state that narrower scope as the deliverable.

findings.title: Production India Address Control prevents promised successful writes
findings.location: requirements.md Requirements 2-3; design.md reused boundaries; tasks.md Task 5
findings.problem: Program.cs registers IndiaAddressControlDeferredAdapter, whose ValidateAndApproveAsync always throws. Create and modify validate supplied addresses through it; only the integration test factory replaces it with a fake. The real host therefore cannot complete normal address-bearing writes.
findings.fix: Add the real adapter and configuration/DI/tests, or explicitly defer address-dependent writes and remove the successful-write acceptance from this ticket. Do not treat the test fake as production readiness.

findings.title: Task ordering contradicts itself
findings.location: tasks.md opening, Task 1, Task 2; design.md implementation-ordered list
findings.problem: The file says apply tasks in order but lists the repository edit as Task 1 and then instructs the user to execute Task 2 before Task 1. Design repeats the reversed order.
findings.fix: Renumber/reorder both documents so preflight/DbContext verification precedes repository, validator, API, tests, and frontend edits.

findings.title: PaginatedResponse contract in design.md is wrong
findings.location: design.md Data models and contracts; PaginatedResponse.cs; tasks.md Task 3
findings.problem: The design declares IReadOnlyCollection<T> Data, while the actual shared record and task implementation use List<T> Data.
findings.fix: Document the exact shared List<T> contract and state that the handler passes its projected List<CustomerResponse>.

findings.title: Schema preflight does not detect all structural mismatches claimed by requirements
findings.location: requirements.md Requirement 10; design.md migration section; tasks.md Task 2 SQL
findings.problem: The SQL checks required table presence and expected indexes but not required columns, types, nullability, lengths, primary keys, or foreign keys. A structurally wrong existing table can pass.
findings.fix: Narrow the requirement to the checked shapes or add sys.columns/types/index/foreign-key comparisons and fail closed on any required mismatch.

findings.title: Forbidden document/external payload behavior is ambiguous
findings.problem: The criterion says the service may reject or omit forbidden content without selecting behavior, status, error code, or atomicity.
findings.fix: Choose one contract, such as rejecting the complete request with HTTP 400 ERR-CUSTOMER-400, safe detail/message, and no Customer/audit writes, and add tests.

findings.title: No-source-modification claim lacks independently verifiable provenance
findings.location: requirements.md Assumption A22; design.md Source boundary
findings.problem: Frontend Git status contains modified tracked and untracked application files. Status alone cannot prove those changes predated spec authoring.
findings.fix: Record a pre-authoring baseline commit/status or preserve the pre-existing changes separately, distinguishing no writes by this review from no earlier authoring changes.

findings.title: Executable task headings do not consistently use CREATE/MODIFY path markers
findings.location: tasks.md Task 5, Task 6, Task 8, and frontend barrels
findings.problem: Several top-level steps use broad labels rather than one CREATE <path> or MODIFY <path> heading per edit.
findings.fix: Give every executable source edit its own path-marked heading and label release-only SQL separately.
